rationales: A nested list is a list placed inside another list, not a list of items and descriptions.
An ordered list numbers its items but does not pair them with descriptions.
An unordered list uses bullets and does not pair terms with descriptions.
A definition list presents terms alongside their descriptions.
A tag is HTML markup and is not itself the clickable destination mechanism described.
A list organizes webpage items and is not the clickable item described.
A hyperlink is clickable text or a graphic that takes the user to another webpage.
A link can be used informally, but the specific term for this webpage feature is hyperlink.
The terminal symbol represents the start or end of a flowchart.
A connector links parts of a flowchart and does not mark its start or end.
A process symbol represents an operation or instruction.
A diamond represents a decision.
1024⁴ bytes is a terabyte, not a petabyte.
1024⁶ bytes is larger than a petabyte.
A petabyte equals 1024⁵ bytes.
1024⁷ bytes is larger than a petabyte.
AND combines two or more propositions.
NOT operates on a single proposition.
OR combines two or more propositions.
Addition is an arithmetic operation, not a logical operator.
Routers connect multiple networks and direct traffic between them.
Channels are communication paths, not the usual objects routers connect.
Addresses identify devices or destinations rather than networks being connected.
Protocols are rules for communication, not networks being connected.
A password is used to authenticate access, rather than being the confidential text that licenses software.
Encryption transforms information and is not the confidential software text itself.
A software key is confidential information used to activate or license the software.
Phishing is a fraudulent attempt to obtain sensitive information.
A nested list is a list inside another list, not the usual choice for unordered options.
An ordered list is appropriate when item order matters.
A definition list pairs terms with descriptions.
An unordered list is appropriate when the options do not need a particular order.
An anchor link can jump to another part of the same page.
A tag is HTML markup, not the name of the same-page navigation link.
A hyperlink is a general clickable link and is not the specific term intended here.
A link is a general term; an anchor link specifically targets a location on the page.
Guess, check, and improve means trying and refining possible solutions, not defining a to-do list.
Divide and conquer means breaking a problem into smaller parts, not the stated to-do-list strategy.
Act it out means simulating a situation, not defining a to-do list.
A prototype is an early model of a solution, not the stated to-do-list strategy.
Input/output is usually shown with a parallelogram.
A diamond represents a decision or condition.
Processing is usually shown with a rectangle.
A connector is usually shown with a small circle or other connector symbol.
Decimal is a base-10 number system, not the system used to represent data internally.
Octal is a base-8 system and is not the fundamental storage representation.
Binary uses 0s and 1s and is the number system digital computers use to store data.
Hexadecimal is a compact way to represent binary values, not the fundamental storage system.
(1000001)₂ equals 65, not 66.
(1000001)₂ equals 65, not 67.
(1000001)₂ equals 65, not 69.
The <u> tag is used to underline text.
The <ul> tag creates an unordered list.
The <ui> tag is not the HTML tag for underlining.
The <uli> tag is not the HTML tag for underlining.
A truth table lists truth values for logical expressions.
A truth value is whether a statement is true or false, not the statement itself.
The sentence makes an assertion that can be judged true or false, so it is a proposition.
A compound proposition combines simpler propositions using logical connectives.
